```artifact
/* Finite State Machine (FSM) for Alarm Subsystem */
states:
  Idle
  HighLeakageActive
  InvoluntaryShutdownActive
  ACMainLossActive

events:
  AverageLeakageMeasured
  ACMainLossDetected
  ACMainRestored
  AlarmTimeout

transitions:
  Idle -> HighLeakageActive
    on: AverageLeakageMeasured
    guard: (average_leakage > 3 L/min) AND (time_window >= X_seconds)
  HighLeakageActive -> Idle
    on: AlarmTimeout
    guard: elapsed_time >= X_seconds
  Idle -> InvoluntaryShutdownActive
    on: ACMainLossDetected
    guard: true
  InvoluntaryShutdownActive -> Idle
    on: ACMainRestored
    guard: true
  InvoluntaryShutdownActive -> InvoluntaryShutdownActive
    on: AlarmTimeout
    guard: elapsed_time < 2_min

/* X_seconds is specified as the period over which the average leakage is calculated */
X_seconds = 60   // Example value from SRS; replace with actual SRS value if provided

/* Priority handling */
priority_levels:
  HighLeakagePriority = High
  InvoluntaryShutdownPriority = Medium
  ACMainLossPriority = Medium

/* Continuous-tone alarm support */
continuous_tone_support = true
```
